# 04 — Document the notice workflow

## Objective
Describe create, edit, approve, reject, search, details, and export as currently implemented.
## Required context and areas
Inspect `NoticesController`, `Notice`, Razor views, and existing tests.
## Change constraints
Documentation only. Do not regularise surprising behaviour or modify source.
## Response format
Workflow diagram/table; state transitions and side effects; evidence; gaps; assumptions; SME questions.
## Assumptions
Treat status strings and code branches as observed implementation only.
## Validation and evidence
Check links and cited locations; compare each transition to persistence/audit behaviour. Record exact commands and review outcome.
